test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the following types of lines with their correct descriptions according to their orientation and characteristics.

Description

A. A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it.

B. A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines.

C. A line that changes its direction continuously.

D. A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane.
solution:
The correct answer is __Option 1**(1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A. A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it:__ Represents an inclined line.
 
• __B. A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines:__ Represents a vertical line.
 
• __C. A line that changes its direction continuously:__ Represents a curved line.
 
• __D. A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane:__ Represents a horizontal line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Inclined Line:**

 
 
• A line that forms an angle with the horizontal plane other than 90° or 0°.
 
• It represents a slope or diagonal direction.
 
 
 
• **Vertical Line:**
 
 
• A line that extends straight up and down and is perpendicular to horizontal lines.
 
• Represents upright or standing direction.
 
 
 
• **Curved Line:**
 
 
• A line that continuously changes its direction.
 
• Examples include circles, arcs, and spirals.
 
 
 
• **Horizontal Line:**
 
 
• A line that runs parallel to the horizon or horizontal plane.
 
• Represents a flat or level direction.
